subject.title: fix(ai): recover stale Responses reasoning replay in streamSimple

question: Should this package-level streamSimple retry become the canonical generic recovery, or should it be folded into the broader implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107266?
rationale: The active branches overlap on error recognition, replay sanitation, and retry budgeting; choosing separate owners risks permanent duplicate recovery stacks even if each patch is individually plausible.

options.title: Canonicalize the package retry
options.body: Use this PR for the generic Responses retry, retain provider-owned prevention separately, and remove or narrow overlapping retry code in the related PRs.

options.title: Fold into the broader fix
options.body: Move the exact package-level coverage into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107266 and close this PR only after that branch has positive real-behavior proof and remains a viable landing path.

options.title: Keep provider-only prevention
options.body: Land only provider-boundary sanitation and accept that other Responses-compatible providers will not receive the generic recovery fallback.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize the package retry
recommendation.body: Use this PR for the generic Responses retry, retain provider-owned prevention separately, and remove or narrow overlapping retry code in the related PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed the adjacent Responses recovery lifecycle and are the strongest available routing candidate for choosing a single retry owner.
